title: Apply typed task-sync delta exchanges atomically with indexed graph admission
outcome: Complete the additive delta planning, intent and outcome contracts and their mixed-history dispatch in the same transaction as admitted graph changes, after indexed closure admission is available.
acceptance: Strict new immutable delta kinds carry origin-qualified feed cuts, typed inventory roots and exact Git provenance without changing any historical record, fingerprint, ID, link or receipt.

The real delta writer owns closure admission, fresh state checks, graph changes and deletions, retained planning and reconciliation heads/holds, exactly one original receipt, ledger event and keyed projections in one atomic transaction; no standalone record-applied API can manufacture completion.
Mixed historical/delta baseline, reconciliation, feed and integrity dispatch is explicit; missing basis refuses with no guessed cursors, semantic substitution or implicit full-scan fallback.

Tests exercise 2,000-task changed selections in both directions, exact receipt replay before payload reads after later movement, mismatched intent, interruption and rollback; ordinary CLI/MCP/model-A wiring remains separately tracked under the parent.

Pending or unreadable restore provenance refuses a fresh strict task-sync continuation, and a changed restore occurrence never inherits old pending authority, with tests executed against the real strict writer using the restore record from w-25e0a28aab8e.

Bo sync ogólnie działa jak należy.” Typed delta-exchange kinds, with mixed-history dispatch and their atomic writer, are a second exchange path beside the working incremental folder exchange on master (eecabd6a).
